description: v7 main PCB probe points for the I2C arms S1 (master end) and S2 (BQ end). Approved picture: lab/procedures/img/v7-probe-points.png.

blocks.text: v7 main board, top side. Hold it with the USB-C socket on the left edge.
The probe points are small, so they are marked in the two zooms below.
Zoom 1, S1: the test pads marked SDA and SCL, beside the ESP32 module

markers.label: A
markers.legend: S1: SDA probe (CH1) on the round test pad marked "SDA" (TPIO43)

markers.label: B
markers.legend: S1: SCL probe (CH2) on the round test pad marked "SCL" (TPIO44)

markers.label: C
markers.legend: S1: ground, short wire to C9.1: the upper end of small capacitor C9 (GND)

blocks.text: Zoom 2, S2: the charger chip (U5) and capacitor C21

markers.label: D
markers.legend: S2: SDA probe (CH1) on U5 pin 6, the RIGHTMOST pin of U5's bottom side

markers.label: E
markers.legend: S2: SCL probe (CH2) on U5 pin 5, the pin just left of D

markers.label: F
markers.legend: S2: ground spring on THIS end of C21 (the end farther from U5)

markers.label: X
markers.legend: USB power: the other end of C21. Never touch, never bridge to F

markers.label: X
markers.legend: USB power: one end of C20. Also keep clear

blocks.text: Rendered from the v7 KiCad layout (commit {commit}). Pin positions are from the layout file, so check under the microscope before probing.
